findings.message: The old line was "run `clutch engine stop` (the running ticket finishes first), take the message through the no-engine Suggestion Box step, then start serve again". The new line is "stop the engine and report it; follow the phase-end triage cadence unless the owner explicitly asks otherwise". It drops the restart, so an unattended run that hits a wedging message leaves the daemon stopped. Nothing else in the prompt restarts it, since the only restart rule is tied to the Reject-queue edit, dismiss and doctor steps. The run is also unattended ('nothing waits for a person'), so it may never recover. The line also names no stop path, unlike every other stop in the diff, which says `clutch_engine_control(action="stop")` or `clutch engine stop`. The ticket's scope covers the triage cadence, not dropping the restart.
findings.paved_road: Keep the stop-then-restart order and name both paths. For example: 'For a pending message whose cause wedges the engine or wastes runs, run `clutch_engine_control(action="stop")` or `clutch engine stop` (the running ticket finishes first), take that message through the no-engine Suggestion Box step as an exception to the phase-end triage cadence, then start serve again with `clutch_engine_start(mode="serve")` or `clutch engine serve --detach`.'
